newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded basis eases in Chicago.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded basis eases in Chicago.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline basis eased in Chicago as sellers continued to outnumber buyers in the spot markets, traders said.
Gasoline prices were generally lower across the board on steady to weakening differentials and futures prices in morning trade.
Unleaded gasoline was bid 1.25 cent a gallon below NYMEX March unleaded in Chicago, and was steady at 1.25 cent a gallon over the print in Group Three.
Low sulphur diesel was talked 4.0/4.25 cents a gallon over NYMEX March heating oil for February deliveries in Chicago and remained 3.0/3.25 cents over the print in Group Three.
